verdicts.why: Black Widow plot: Natasha wins Melina over, they swap places with face masks, Melina frees Alexei and Yelena and wrecks one engine, sending the Red Room into a controlled crash. The file has no record of her changing sides.
Film plot: Sue negotiates with Harvey Elder to evacuate New York to Subterranea. Fandom covers Sue's peace deal and Elder greeting the evacuation buses. The file still ends with him At large.
Age of Ultron plot: the twins side with the Avengers in Sokovia, and Pietro dies shielding Barton from gunfire. The file has no death record before WandaVision.
Fandom: Groot grows wings and glides them down, then Quill slams Theel into the ground and kills him. Wikipedia: they jump off the ship with Theel 'whom they kill'. So he does not die in the fall.
Film plot: Shalla-Bal stops Johnny's sacrifice and pushes Galactus into the portal herself, and it closes behind them. Fandom lists her status as Unknown, so Missing fits.
Wikipedia: 'a repentant Skurge sacrifices himself to save the citizens'. Fandom: he fights off the Berserkers boarding the Statesman, then jumps onto the Bridge and dies holding off the horde.
Episode 3 ('Worst Behavior') shows the Hand resurrecting Elektra as the Black Sky under Alexandra's tutelage. Alexandra dies in episode 6, so the tag 7 cannot be right.

The killing is in episode 8, but the record ends with him fleeing, and that comes out in episode 9 ('Speak of the Devil'), where Wesley tells Fisk that Hoffman disappeared after killing Blake (fandom lists DD109 as a mention). So the last event is in episode 9, and tagging it 8 would put that event in the wrong episode.
Episode 2 ('Two Dead Men'): 'Castle tortures and kills Wolf' at his home (fandom: Carson Wolf's Residence, ref TP102). Wolf only turns up in photos or mentions after that.
The deal (Inhumans and gravitonium in return for protecting Earth) comes out in 5x15 'Rise and Shine' (series episode 103). Fandom cites AoS515 for it, and 5x19 (episode 107) is the Remorath raid.
Talbot's last season 2 appearance is AoS214 'Love in the Time of Hydra' (episode 36), where he is already working with Coulson. Fandom lists no appearance in 2x22 (episode 44).
Ruby cuts off both of Yo-Yo's arms with her chakram in 5x11 'All the Comforts of Home', which is series episode 99 (Wikipedia episode table), not episode 103.
Episode 2 ('Please'): a fellow inmate attacks Fisk and Nadeem moves him out of prison. Fandom puts Evans's staged stabbing in DD302, and he is only mentioned in episode 7.
Scarfe's only season 2 appearance is in the LC205 ('All Souled Out', episode 5) flashbacks: framing Cockroach with Misty and breaking down after Earl's death. He is only mentioned in episode 8.

Episode 1 ('Now Is Not the End'): the bomb is traced to a Roxxon refinery, where Van Ert and Brannis are building nitramene weapons and the building implodes (fandom ref AC101). Episode 2 only has Van Ert's arrest.

Episodes 8 and 9: Joy breaks BB out to steal the bowl and turns on Davos, who pushes her off a balcony. Ward then shoots Chen Wu and carries her away (fandom ref IF209). The file has no record of this turn.

Fandom: Raymond pays Brannis and keeps the nitramene bomb in his safe, so he is the buyer, not the seller. Peggy takes it, and Demidov (Leviathan) shoots him. The only change is lowercase 'nitramene', to match the index and Wikipedia.

value.text: In episode 1, Raymond buys Howard Stark's stolen nitramene from Leet Brannis, and after Peggy takes it from his safe, a Leviathan assassin kills him.

verdicts.why: Agent Carter season 1 has 8 episodes, so S2E9 'A Little Song and Dance' is series episode 17, not 19 (Wikipedia table: EpisodeNumber 17). The current tag 17 is correct.

This record sums up several episodes, and its last event, Werner in S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, is shown in episode 55 ('Bouncing Back', AoS311), where he is brought in and revived from his vegetative state. The tag is valid, and the rewrite drops his HYDRA backstory.

Episode 104 ('Inside Voices'): Simmons convinces Yo-Yo to help free Fitz, and they get Mack to release him. He then goes with them to England (episode 105), so 'In custody' is wrong for where episode 104 leaves him.
